title: Hypochondres
summary: HYPOCHON'DRES HYPOCHON'DRIA, noun plural [Gr. a cartilage.] 1. In anatomy, the sides of the belly under the cartilages of the spurious ribs; the spaces on each side of the epigastric region. 2. Hypoch
